_readme: Edit this file to update the curated calendar. Change status to 'live' once real sales replace the placeholders. Sale fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD, sorts the list), dateLabel (what readers see), sale, house, city, url, note, flag, flagUrgent. Optional 'lots' array per sale: artist, title, year, estimate, url, note. Never copy catalogue images or catalogue text.

sales.note: Domestic sale. No remittance and no import duty for Indian residents.
Check export status on any Navratna lot before you register.
Decorative arts, silver, textiles and rare books. A large share is over a hundred years old, which makes it non-exportable from India whoever buys it.

lots.title: Himalaya, numbered edition
lots.note: Roerich is one of the nine artists declared an art treasure in 1979. Whether a numbered print edition falls inside that scope is not obvious, and the answer decides whether you can take it home.

lots.title: Four first editions and view books
lots.note: Books and records of historical interest reach the antiquity threshold at seventy-five years rather than a hundred. All four are well past it.

lots.artist: Nineteenth-century European and Japanese decorative arts
lots.title: Barbedienne, Osler, Baccarat, Odiot, Meiji bronze
lots.note: Antiquities by age. Also check materials on the furniture and inlay, since rosewood and ivory carry separate restrictions in every corridor.

sales.note: Sterling settlement. Budget the remittance before the estimate, not after.
